notes.title: Dream of a Nightmarish Runaway 1.41
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309646/3c416db7f5b2406dfaaf2093ebe3659463c52e6f.png[/img]
Hello Dreamers!

Christmas is coming! So ONImations decided to release the first bigger update whitch will
contain polish localization, and something more :).

Dream of a Nightmarish Runaway update 1.41 is coming on 12/24/2024!

What you can find there:
[list]
[*]Polish localization.
[*]Mac support.
[*]Gallery of achievements.
[*]Brand new logo.
[*]New font for every language.
[*]New trailer.
[*]New screenshots.
[*]A few suprises to be found.
[*]A few minor bug fixes.
[/list]
Have fun and see you soon!

ONImations
